name: Forge Platform
description: Workbench, editor, settings and the plugin system.

settings.title: Keymap
settings.description: auto (the PHPStorm keymap of the platform), $default, macOS, a bundled keymap (VSCode, VSCode OSX, Eclipse, Eclipse (Mac OS X), Sublime Text, Sublime Text (Mac OS X), Emacs) or the name of a user keymap.

settings.title: Changed shortcuts (Windows / Linux)
settings.description: One entry per action: the action id, then its shortcuts, separated by tabs.

settings.title: Changed shortcuts (macOS)
settings.description: One entry per action: the action id, then its shortcuts, separated by tabs.

settings.title: Changed shortcuts (other bundled keymaps)
settings.description: One entry per action: the keymap id, the action id, then its shortcuts, separated by tabs.

settings.title: User keymaps
settings.description: Keymaps made with Duplicate or Derive: name, parent keymap and the changed shortcuts (one action per line: the action id, then its shortcuts, separated by tabs).

settings.title: Zoom
settings.description: Scales the whole IDE: menus, tool windows, dialogs and the editor (View | Appearance | Zoom IDE).

settings.title: Font size
settings.description: Editor font size in Presentation Mode (View | Appearance | Enter Presentation Mode).

settings.title: Layouts
settings.description: Tool window layouts saved with Window | Layouts | Save Current Layout as New…; each entry has a name and the layout as JSON.

settings.title: Font
settings.description: Font used for menus, tool windows and dialogs.

settings.title: Compact mode
settings.description: Reduces paddings and the height of toolbars and tool window headers.

settings.title: Show tool window bars
settings.description: The stripes with tool window buttons along the window edges.

settings.title: Main menu
settings.description: Hamburger menu: behind the button at the left of the main toolbar. Merged: the menu names in the main toolbar. Separate toolbar: a classic menu bar above the main toolbar.

settings.title: Smooth scrolling
settings.description: Animate scrolling in lists and trees.

settings.title: Show splash screen on startup
settings.description: The Forge wordmark fills with molten metal while the IDE loads, and offers updates.

settings.title: Window controls
settings.description: Look of the title bar buttons of the main window and dialogs. "Native" lets the operating system draw the title bar.

settings.title: Open files with single click
settings.description: In the Project tool window a single click opens files and expands folders. Turn it off to select with a single click and open with a double click, like PHPStorm.

settings.title: Always select opened file
settings.description: The Project tool window selects the file of the active editor whenever you switch editors (PHPStorm's Autoscroll from Source). Also in the tool window's Options menu.

settings.title: Show excluded files
settings.description: The Project tool window lists excluded folders and files (orange) instead of hiding them. Options menu (⋮) › Show Excluded Files.

settings.title: Show members
settings.description: PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript and Lua files expand to their classes, functions, methods and properties; a click on a member opens it. Options menu (⋮) › Show Members.

settings.title: Compact middle packages
settings.description: Folders that contain only one folder are shown as one row (`src/Acme/Shop`). Options menu (⋮) › Compact Middle Packages.

settings.title: Folders always on top
settings.description: Folders come before files; turn it off to sort folders and files together. Options menu (⋮) › Folders Always on Top.

settings.title: Sort by type
settings.description: Files are sorted by their extension, then by name. Options menu (⋮) › Sort by Type.

settings.title: File nesting
settings.description: Files with the same name as another file and a child suffix of a nesting rule are shown below it (`app.js` below `app.ts`). Options menu (⋮) › File Nesting…

settings.title: File nesting rules
settings.description: Parent file suffix and child file suffixes (separated by `;`) of File Nesting. Empty uses PHPStorm's predefined rules. Edit them in the Project tool window: Options menu (⋮) › File Nesting…

settings.title: Excluded and resource folders
settings.description: Folders marked as Excluded, Resource Root or Test Resources Root (Settings | Directories, Project view: Mark Directory as), stored in the project. Kind `included` cancels the default exclusion of a folder like `node_modules`. Excluded folders are left out of the indexes, Find in Files, Search Everywhere, inspections and local history.

settings.title: Exclude files
settings.description: File and folder name patterns excluded from the project, separated by `;` (`*.min.js;tmp`).

settings.title: Shared scopes
settings.description: Named scopes stored in the project (`.forge/settings.toml`, shared with the team through version control): name and pattern in PHPStorm's scope language, e.g. `file:app//*.php&&!test:*..*`.

settings.title: Local scopes
settings.description: Named scopes stored in your user settings only (not shared): name and pattern.

settings.title: Enable file colors
settings.description: Tint files by scope with the colors below.

settings.title: Local colors
settings.description: Colors stored in your user settings: scope name and color (Blue, Green, Orange, Rose, Violet, Yellow, Gray). The first scope containing a file wins; local colors come before shared ones.

settings.title: Shared colors
settings.description: Colors stored in the project (`.forge/settings.toml`): scope name and color.

settings.title: Autoscroll to source
settings.description: A single click on a Structure tool window node moves the editor to it. Turn it off to select with a single click and navigate with a double click.

settings.title: Autoscroll from source
settings.description: The Structure tool window selects the member at the caret as you move through the editor.

settings.title: Navigation bar
settings.description: Where the navigation bar (project, folders, file and members at the caret) is shown: Top: above the editor, with the path in the status bar too. In status bar: only in the status bar. Don't show: Jump to Navigation Bar (Alt+Home) shows it as a popup. View | Appearance | Navigation Bar.

settings.title: Show members in the navigation bar
settings.description: Add the class and function at the caret after the file name. View | Appearance | Members in Navigation Bar.

settings.title: Template data languages
settings.description: Language of the content between template tags, one entry per pattern: `legacy/latex/*.tpl=latex`, `*.mail.twig=text`. Languages: html, xml, latex, css, scss, less, javascript, typescript, json, sql, yaml, ini, shell, text. Compound names like `invoice.tex.twig` are detected automatically. Applies to files opened afterwards.

settings.title: Template delimiters
settings.description: Delimiters of a template language in a data language, e.g. Smarty in LaTeX, where `{` is part of the content. Templates without an entry use the language's default delimiters. Applies to open editors.

settings.title: File and code templates
settings.description: Templates added in Settings | Editor | File and Code Templates and the changed text of built-in ones (kind "file", "include" or "code", name, extension, text). Built-in templates without an entry use their default text.

settings.title: File name patterns
settings.description: Patterns added to a file type (`{ fileType = "php", pattern = "*.module" }`) or removed from it (`action = "remove"`). A pattern added to one type is taken away from the others.

settings.title: Custom file types
settings.description: File types created in Settings | Editor | File Types with their syntax highlighting: name, description, comments, number formats, keyword lists 1-4 and options.

settings.title: Ignored Files and Folders
settings.description: Files and folders with these names are hidden from the Project view, separated by ';' (`*` and `?` wildcards).

settings.title: Open project in
settings.description: Where File | Open and the recent projects open a project while another one is open in this window.

settings.title: Default project directory
settings.description: New projects are created here unless you pick another location.

settings.title: Save files if the IDE is switched to a different application
Save files if the IDE is idle
Synchronize external changes when switching to the IDE window
Check for updates on startup
settings.description: The splash screen checks at most once a day. Help | Check for Updates… checks at any time.

settings.title: Update channel
settings.description: Beta also offers pre-releases.

settings.title: Update feed URL
settings.description: The latest.json of the update feed. Empty: the GitHub releases of Forge for the selected channel. Updates must be signed with the key this build was made with.

settings.title: Soft-wrap files
settings.description: Wrap long lines visually in files matching the patterns below.

settings.title: Ensure every saved file ends with a line break
Maximum number of contents to keep in clipboard
settings.description: Entries of Paste from History (Ctrl+Shift+V). The history is kept until Forge closes.

settings.title: Render documentation comments
settings.description: Show PHPDoc, JSDoc and LuaDoc comments as formatted text. Toggle one with Ctrl+Alt+Q or its gutter icon.

settings.title: Show sticky lines while scrolling
settings.description: The headers of the classes, functions, blocks, rules and tags around the top of the editor stay visible. Click one to jump to it.

settings.title: Show breadcrumbs
settings.description: The classes, functions, rules and tags around the caret. Click one to go there; the arrow next to it lists its siblings.

settings.title: Use Reader mode
settings.description: Open files you only read in Reader mode. Toggle it with the Reader Mode button at the top right of the editor.

settings.title: Enable postfix completion
settings.description: Type a template key after an expression, e.g. $user.if or items.forof, to wrap it.

settings.title: Show postfix templates in the completion autopopup
Templates
settings.description: Clear a template to stop offering it.

settings.title: Expand abbreviation with
settings.description: Live templates and postfix templates expand first when they match.

settings.title: Enable Emmet
settings.description: In HTML, Blade, Twig and other template files, Vue templates and the HTML of PHP files.

settings.title: Enable abbreviation preview
settings.description: Show the expanded markup in a popup while typing an abbreviation.

settings.title: Enable automatic URL recognition while wrapping text with <a> tag
Enable Emmet
settings.description: In CSS, SCSS, Less, Sass and Stylus, and in <style> blocks: m10, p10-20, df, pos:a, bgc#fff …

settings.title: Class attribute
settings.description: Attribute written for .class abbreviations in JSX and TSX files.

settings.title: Show color preview in the gutter
settings.description: Swatches next to colors in CSS, markup and scripts; click one to open the color picker.

settings.title: Recently used colors
settings.description: Colors picked in the color picker, newest first.

settings.title: Tab limit
settings.description: Maximum number of tabs per editor group; 0 keeps every tab open. Pinned tabs are never closed by the limit.

settings.title: When the tab limit is reached, close non-modified tabs first
When the current tab is closed, activate
Show pin icon on pinned tabs
Patterns
settings.description: Regular expressions matched in comments, one per entry. Add a tab and `case` after a pattern to make it case-sensitive.

settings.title: By default expand with
settings.description: Key that expands a live template abbreviation.

settings.title: User and changed templates
settings.description: New templates and changes to built-in ones: group, abbreviation, description, text, contexts (comma-separated), variables (JSON), builtin (id of the replaced built-in template) and removed.

settings.title: Disabled templates
settings.description: Ids (`group/abbreviation`) of templates that do not expand.

settings.title: Disabled injection rules
settings.description: Ids of the built-in injection rules that are turned off, e.g. `php-html` or `js-sql-keywords`. `// language=` comments always inject.

settings.title: Un-injected places
settings.description: Strings turned off with Un-inject Language (`path#key`); a string is injected again when its text changes.

settings.title: Notification groups
settings.description: How each group is shown, one entry per group: the group name, a tab, then `balloon`, `sticky` or `log`.

settings.title: Scheme
settings.description: Color scheme of the editor: Ember, Anvil or the name of a user scheme. Empty follows the theme (Ember for dark themes, Anvil for light ones).

settings.title: User schemes
settings.description: Schemes made with Duplicate or Import: name, parent (Ember or Anvil) and the changed attributes, one per line: the attribute key, then fg=#rrggbb, bg=#rrggbb, bold, italic, effect=<type> and effectColor=#rrggbb.

settings.title: Enable ligatures
settings.description: Render character sequences like -> and !== as a single glyph if the font supports it.

settings.title: Enable EditorConfig support
settings.description: Indents, line separators, charset and the On Save options of .editorconfig files override these settings.

settings.title: Detect and use existing file indents for editing
settings.description: Files indented differently from the code style keep their indent; the status bar marks it with *.

settings.title: Parameter names
settings.description: Show parameter names at call sites for literal and null arguments.

settings.title: Inferred variable types
settings.description: The type of variables and properties without a declared type.

settings.title: Return types of closures and functions
settings.description: The inferred return type after the parameter list when none is declared.

settings.title: JavaScript and TypeScript
settings.description: Also Vue, Svelte and Astro files.

settings.title: Implementations and inheritors
settings.description: Show "2 implementations", "3 inheritors" and "1 override" above PHP classes and methods (Code Vision). Click to go there.

settings.title: External Tools
settings.description: Programs run from Tools | External Tools, the editor and Project view context menus, the keymap and Before launch tasks: name, group, description, program, arguments and working directory with macros such as $FilePath$, plus the options and output filters ($FILE_PATH$:$LINE$, one per line).

settings.title: Environment
settings.description: Environment of http-client.env.json (and http-client.private.env.json) that requests of .http files run with. Empty: dev, else the first one; $none: no environment. Chosen in the toolbar of .http editors.

settings.title: Maximum matches in the Find window
settings.description: 0 shows every match. Searches that match millions of lines are slow to transfer and display. The Search Everywhere popup always stays limited.

settings.title: Fuzzy matching
settings.description: Search Everywhere (Files, Classes, Symbols) and Go to File match abbreviations such as "orco" for OrderController. Turn it off to match only text that contains what you typed.

settings.title: Index in the background at low CPU priority
settings.description: The search index of a project is built and refreshed on threads below normal priority, so the IDE and other programs keep their share of the CPU. Turn it off to index as fast as possible. Applies when a project is opened.

settings.title: Send requests from
settings.description: Remote projects only: "Remote host" sends the requests of .http files through an SSH tunnel from the project's host, so localhost URLs reach the services running there. "This machine" sends them from here.

settings.title: Reformat code
settings.description: Reformat Code (Ctrl+Alt+L) when the file is saved.

settings.title: Reformat
settings.description: "Changed lines" reformats only the lines changed since the last commit; files that are not committed yet are reformatted completely.

settings.title: Reformat file types
settings.description: File type ids (php, javascript, ...) reformatted on save; empty means all file types.

settings.title: Optimize imports
settings.description: Remove unused imports and sort the others (PHP).

settings.title: Rearrange code
settings.description: Order class members: constants, properties, constructor, methods (PHP).

settings.title: Run code cleanup
settings.description: Apply the safe quick fixes: unused imports, unnecessary semicolons, a redundant closing tag (PHP).

settings.title: Also run on autosave
settings.description: Run Reformat code, Optimize imports, Rearrange code and Run code cleanup when files are saved automatically too. External tools only run on explicit save (Ctrl+S).

settings.title: Default layout
settings.description: How Markdown files open. The buttons in the top-right corner of the editor switch it per file.

settings.title: Synchronize scrolling between the editor and the preview
Front matter
settings.description: The YAML (---) or TOML (+++) block at the start of a file.

settings.title: Mermaid
settings.description: Render ```mermaid code blocks as diagrams.

settings.title: Show chessboard
settings.description: Transparent areas of images are drawn over a chessboard pattern.

settings.title: Show grid
settings.description: Pixel grid lines when the zoom is 300% or more.

settings.title: First row is header
settings.description: Default of the table view's header toggle.

settings.title: Highlight usages of element at caret
settings.description: Highlights the usages of the symbol at the caret in the file (reads and writes in different colors), also on the scrollbar.

settings.title: Custom scope
settings.description: A scope pattern (`file:app//*.php&&!test:*..*`, see Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Scopes) or file globs separated by ';', where '!' excludes (app/**/*.php; !app/Legacy/**).

settings.title: Named scope
settings.description: A scope of the Scopes page used as the custom scope; empty uses the pattern above.

settings.title: Keep local history for (working days)
settings.description: Only days with changes count. Older revisions and labels are removed when a project opens and every few hours.

settings.title: Maximum history size per project (MB)
settings.description: When the stored contents grow larger, the oldest revisions are removed first.

settings.title: Do not record files larger than (KB)
settings.description: Larger files and binary files are left out of Local History.

settings.title: Excluded folders
settings.description: Files in folders with these names (or project-relative paths like `storage/logs`) are never recorded.

name: Git
description: Commit, branches, log, diff and merge conflicts for Git repositories.

settings.title: Path to Git executable
settings.description: Leave as `git` to use the one on PATH. Remote projects always use the git of their host.

settings.title: Update method
settings.description: How Update Project (Ctrl+T) brings in remote changes. Branch default follows the branch's git configuration (pull.rebase).

settings.title: Fetch remotes automatically
settings.description: In the background, for repositories whose branch has an upstream. Failures are ignored.

settings.title: Require blank line between subject and body
Warn if CRLF line separators are about to be committed
Sign commits with GPG/SSH key
settings.description: Commits from Forge are signed (`git commit -S`) with the key chosen in Configure GPG Key…, or the one in git config (`user.signingkey`). Forge never changes git config.

settings.title: Signing key
settings.description: `openpgp:<key id>` or `ssh:<public key file>`; empty uses `user.signingkey` from git config.

settings.title: Add the 'cherry-picked from <hash>' suffix when picking commits pushed to protected branches
Protected branches
settings.description: Branch names or patterns (`*` wildcards) separated by `;`. Log actions never rewrite commits that are already pushed to them.

settings.title: Create changelists automatically
settings.description: Apply Patch and Unshelve put the changes into a new changelist named after the patch or the shelved changes.

settings.title: Reformat code
settings.description: Reformat the committed files with the code style before committing.

settings.title: Analyze code
settings.description: Run the inspections on the committed files; errors and warnings ask Review or Commit Anyway.

settings.title: Check TODO
settings.description: Look for TODO items (Settings | Editor | TODO patterns) in the changed lines.

settings.title: Cleanup
settings.description: Run code cleanup on the committed files.

settings.title: Run Tests
settings.description: Run the chosen run configuration before committing; failing tests ask Review or Commit Anyway.

settings.title: Run Git hooks
settings.description: Unchecked commits with --no-verify (pre-commit and commit-msg hooks are skipped).

settings.title: Commit message history size
settings.description: How many commit messages Commit Message History (Ctrl+M) keeps for each project.

name: GitLab, Forgejo and GitHub
description: Merge and pull requests, code review, issues and CI pipelines for GitLab, Forgejo/Gitea and GitHub.

settings.title: Show the CI status of the current branch in the status bar
Refresh merge requests and pipelines every (seconds)
settings.description: 0 turns automatic refresh off.

name: Terminal
description: Integrated terminal emulator with shell integration and SSH sessions.

settings.title: Shell path
settings.description: Leave empty to use the system default shell.

settings.title: Audible bell
settings.description: Play a short tone when a program rings the terminal bell.

settings.title: Shell integration
settings.description: bash and zsh report their working directory (shown in the tab tooltip) and command boundaries (green and red marks in the scrollbar for succeeded and failed commands). Applies to new sessions.

settings.title: Start directory
settings.description: Leave empty to start in the project root.

settings.title: Environment variables
settings.description: One NAME=value pair per entry.

settings.title: Show application title
settings.description: Name terminal tabs after the title the running program sets, e.g. Claude Code's current task.

settings.title: Show progress in the status bar
settings.description: Programs such as Claude Code, winget and systemd report progress (OSC 9;4). It is always shown on the terminal tab.

settings.title: Use Option as Meta key
settings.description: macOS only.

settings.title: Font
settings.description: Leave empty to use the editor font. Missing symbols fall back to installed Nerd Fonts and emoji fonts.

settings.title: Renderer
settings.description: WebGL draws on the GPU and is the fastest. Automatic falls back to DOM when WebGL is unavailable.

settings.title: Scrollback buffer
settings.description: Number of lines kept above the visible area.

name: Vim
description: Vim emulation like IdeaVim: Normal, Insert, Visual and command-line modes, motions, operators, text objects, registers, macros, ex commands and ~/.ideavimrc. Turn it on with Tools | Vim.

settings.title: Enable Vim emulation
settings.description: Same as Tools | Vim (Ctrl+Alt+V).

settings.title: Configuration file
settings.description: Leave empty to read ~/.ideavimrc (or ~/_ideavimrc, ~/.config/ideavim/ideavimrc). Supports set, map/noremap, let mapleader, sethandler and :action mappings.

settings.title: Shortcuts
settings.description: Who handles a shortcut in the editor while Vim emulation is on: Vim or the IDE. sethandler lines in ~/.ideavimrc take precedence.

name: Run/Debug
description: Run/Debug configurations, the Run tool window and shell script configurations.

settings.title: Override console cycle buffer size (KB)
settings.description: Run consoles drop their oldest lines beyond this size. Applies to runs started afterwards.

settings.title: Auto-test delay (seconds)
settings.description: With Toggle Auto-Test on, a test run reruns this long after the last file was saved.

runConfigurationTypes.name: Shell Script
runConfigurationTypes.description: Run a script file or a script text with a shell.

name: Debugger
description: Shared debugging layer for every language pack: Debug Adapter Protocol sessions (launch, Attach to Process, Attach to DAP server, core dumps), logpoints and watchpoints, and the Memory, Disassembly and Registers views. Packs add their debug adapters; LLDB and GDB are built in.

settings.title: LLDB DAP executable
settings.description: Path of lldb-dap (lldb-vscode in older LLVM releases). Empty: lldb-dap on the PATH.

settings.title: GDB executable
settings.description: GDB 14 or newer (its built-in DAP server, gdb -i dap). Empty: gdb on the PATH.

settings.title: Debug adapter request timeout (ms)
settings.description: How long Forge waits for an answer of a debug adapter before it reports an error.

settings.title: Log Debug Adapter Protocol messages
settings.description: Write every message to and from debug adapters to the Forge log (trace level).

settings.title: Show variable values in editor while debugging
settings.description: For debug adapter sessions; PHP uses the setting under Languages & Frameworks | PHP | Debug.

initCommands.description: LLDB commands run before the target is created

name: Database Tools and SQL
description: Data sources, SQL consoles, schema browsing and table editing for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite.

settings.title: Result set page size
settings.description: Rows fetched per page in consoles and table editors.

settings.title: Suggest data sources from .env files
settings.description: Offer to add the database configured in Laravel's DB_* or Symfony's DATABASE_URL.

name: Docker and Kubernetes
description: Services tool window: Docker containers, images, volumes and networks, Docker Compose projects and Kubernetes workloads, with logs, exec and gutter ▶ for compose files and Dockerfiles.

settings.title: Socket path
settings.description: Unix socket (e.g. /var/run/docker.sock, ~/.docker/run/docker.sock) or named pipe (\\.\pipe\docker_engine). Empty: the first existing default.

settings.title: Engine API URL
settings.description: For TCP connections, e.g. tcp://192.168.1.20:2376.

settings.title: Certificates folder
settings.description: Folder with ca.pem, cert.pem and key.pem (like DOCKER_CERT_PATH).

settings.title: SSH host
settings.description: For SSH connections: ssh://user@host[:port] or a Host alias of ~/.ssh/config. Keys come from the ssh-agent and ~/.ssh; the host key must be in known_hosts.

settings.title: Docker socket on the host
settings.description: For SSH connections and Docker on a remote project's host. Empty: /var/run/docker.sock (rootless: /run/user/<uid>/docker.sock).

settings.title: In remote projects, connect to Docker on the remote host
settings.description: Uses the Docker daemon of the project's host through the project's SSH connection (no extra login); compose, builds and exec terminals run on that host. Off: the connection above.

settings.title: Docker context
settings.description: For Docker context connections: a context of `docker context ls` (~/.docker/contexts).

settings.title: Docker executable
settings.description: Used for docker compose, image builds and exec terminals.

settings.title: Show the last log lines
settings.description: Lines loaded when a Log tab opens; new lines follow.

settings.title: Registry accounts
settings.description: One entry per registry: server, a tab, the user name. Passwords are kept in the OS keychain.

settings.title: Kubeconfig file
settings.description: Empty: $KUBECONFIG or ~/.kube/config.

settings.title: Default context
settings.description: Empty: the kubeconfig's current-context.

settings.title: Default namespace
settings.description: Empty: the context's namespace, else default.

settings.title: kubectl executable
settings.description: Used on this machine for exec terminals in pods and for applying manifests.

settings.title: In remote projects, use Kubernetes of the project host
settings.description: Contexts come from the host's kubeconfig ($KUBECONFIG or ~/.kube/config) and kubectl runs on the host: logs, exec terminals, port forwards (tunnelled back through the project's SSH connection) and applying manifests. Off: this machine's kubeconfig.

settings.title: kubectl from the project host
settings.description: One entry per host: user@host, a tab, the kubectl path on that host (e.g. /usr/local/bin/kubectl or k3s kubectl). Hosts without an entry use kubectl from their PATH.

name: Deployment
description: Deployment to SFTP, FTP/FTPS and local or mounted folders: path mappings, excluded paths, upload, download, sync and compare with the deployed version, automatic upload on save, the Remote Host and File Transfer tool windows.

commands.title: Sync with Deployed to Default Server

settings.title: Exclude items by name
settings.description: Names separated by semicolons; * and ? are wildcards. These files and folders are never uploaded, downloaded or compared.

settings.title: Overwrite up-to-date files
settings.description: Off: files whose deployed copy has the same size and is not older are skipped.

settings.title: Preserve files timestamps
settings.description: The copy gets the modification time of the source (FTP servers need MFMT).

settings.title: Delete target items when source ones do not exist
settings.description: When a folder is uploaded or downloaded, files that exist only on the target are deleted.

settings.title: Warn when uploading over newer file
Upload changed files automatically to the default server
settings.description: Off in Safe Mode: an untrusted project never uploads on its own.

name: PHP
description: PHP language support: completion, inspections, navigation and refactorings via Intelephense.

settings.title: PHP language level
settings.description: Inspections and completion follow the syntax of this version.

settings.title: CLI Interpreter
settings.description: The interpreter that runs scripts and tests: the name of an interpreter of the CLI Interpreters dialog, or the path of a local php executable.

settings.title: CLI Interpreters
settings.description: PHP interpreters available in every project: local, Docker, Docker Compose, SSH and WSL (edited in the CLI Interpreters dialog).

settings.title: CLI Interpreters of this project
settings.description: Interpreters marked "Visible only for this project".

settings.title: Test frameworks
settings.description: PHPUnit, Pest, Codeception, Behat and PHPSpec per CLI interpreter: Composer autoloader or path to the executable, default configuration and bootstrap files. Frameworks the project uses are detected.

settings.title: Include path
settings.description: Extra directories indexed as libraries (e.g. global PEAR or framework stubs).

settings.title: Source roots
settings.description: Folders marked as Sources Root or Test Sources Root with their package prefix (Settings | Directories, Project view: Mark Directory as). They change the PSR-4 roots composer.json declares (kind `none` unmarks one); New PHP Class, Move Class and the namespace inspection use them.

settings.title: Inspections from PHPStorm metadata and attributes
settings.description: Deprecated symbols, expected values, #[Immutable] writes, unused #[Pure] results, unreachable code after exit points and the PSR-0/PSR-4 namespace check.

settings.title: Default stubs path
settings.description: A phpstorm-stubs checkout used for PHP's own classes, functions and constants (Go to Declaration on \Throwable, array_map). Empty: Forge downloads JetBrains' phpstorm-stubs into its cache folder on first use, or uses Intelephense's stubs.

settings.title: Language server
settings.description: Started automatically when a PHP project opens.

settings.title: When Intelephense is not installed
settings.description: Forge downloads Intelephense from the npm registry into its own directory (and Node.js when none is installed). Intelephense is not bundled with Forge.
